title: Practice: a release plugin with a guard hook (TypeScript)

cases.id: m1 the hook script blocks pushes deletes and piped downloads in any spelling
cases.says: The guard refuses pushes, forced recursive deletes and piped downloads in every spelling, with a reason, and leaves safe commands alone

cases.id: e1 edits to protected paths stop with exit two and a reason
cases.says: Edits to protected paths stop with exit code 2 and a reason, in any of three tools and with Windows separators

cases.id: e2 an event it cannot read blocks the call and other tools are left alone
cases.says: An unreadable event blocks the call, while other tools and a Bash event with no command are left alone

cases.id: e3 the hook is registered for every tool it guards and found through the plugin root
cases.says: The hook is registered once for the three tools it guards and found through the plugin root

cases.id: e4 the skills set the right invocation rules and approve only patterns
cases.says: The skills have the right invocation rules, approve only patterns and say when to use them

cases.id: e5 the subagent only reads is bounded and uses only fields a plugin agent honours
cases.says: The subagent only reads, is bounded, and uses only fields a plugin agent honours

cases.id: e6 the manifest names the plugin and pins its dependency to patch updates
cases.says: The manifest names the plugin and pins the dependency to patch updates

cases.id: e7 the team settings register the marketplace the enabled plugin comes from
cases.says: The team settings register a marketplace and enable the plugin from it
